releasePlan.notes: Flag gates the player callsign login overlay. control=skip login (game starts directly, original pre-PR behaviour). v1=show ENTER CALLSIGN overlay, persist callsign to localStorage, re-identify LaunchDarkly context from anonymous-player to per-player key. The loginOverlay DOM element exists on both paths; control hides it via display:none. No prerequisite flags — login screen is net-new and does not depend on any upstream flag-gated capability.
